items.title: What is a network firewall?
paragraphs: A network firewall is a hardware or software security control used to manage traffic between defined networks or systems according to configured rules.
Depending on the product, it may also provide additional capabilities such as application awareness, intrusion prevention, VPN connectivity and security logging.

items.title: What is a next-generation firewall?
paragraphs: A next-generation firewall (NGFW) extends conventional traffic filtering with additional capabilities that may include application identification, intrusion prevention and advanced security services.
The available features, performance and licensing requirements differ by manufacturer and product model.

items.title: Does Integrated Solutions Technology supply enterprise firewalls in Nigeria?
paragraphs: Integrated Solutions Technology offers Firewall Supply, Installation & Licensing within its IT Services & Technical Support division.
Specific firewall models, manufacturers, licence options and equipment availability should be confirmed during the procurement process.

items.title: How much does an enterprise firewall cost in Nigeria?
paragraphs: Firewall pricing depends on the manufacturer, model, performance capacity, number of interfaces, required security services, support level and subscription duration.
A quotation should identify the appliance cost separately from applicable licences, subscriptions, installation and other services.

items.title: Can you supply firewalls from Fortinet, Sophos, Cisco or Palo Alto Networks?
paragraphs: Products from these manufacturers may be considered where suitable for the customer's requirements.
Actual sourcing capability, availability, model compatibility and commercial terms must be confirmed. Manufacturer-authorised reseller or partner status should not be assumed.

items.title: How do I choose the right firewall for my business?
paragraphs: Selection should consider your network design, internet bandwidth, expected traffic, user count, connected sites, required security functions and future capacity.
It is also important to evaluate performance with the intended security features enabled rather than relying only on headline firewall throughput figures.

items.title: What is the difference between a firewall appliance and a virtual firewall?
paragraphs: A physical firewall appliance runs on dedicated hardware.

A virtual firewall runs as software within a supported virtualisation or cloud environment. The appropriate choice depends on infrastructure architecture, performance requirements, licensing and operational responsibilities.

items.title: Do small businesses need enterprise firewalls?
paragraphs: Smaller organisations may benefit from suitable business-grade firewalls when they need defined access controls, supported security services, remote connectivity or network segmentation.
The correct solution depends on the environment and risk requirements, not simply the size of the business.

items.title: What is the difference between a router and a firewall?
paragraphs: A router primarily directs traffic between networks. A firewall applies security policies to control permitted traffic.
Some products combine routing and firewall capabilities, but the available security features and administrative controls vary.

items.title: Can you install a firewall on an existing office network?
paragraphs: Yes, where the proposed equipment is suitable for the existing infrastructure.
The installation plan should review current routing, addressing, connections, security requirements and the potential effect on users and applications.

items.title: Does firewall installation require internet downtime?
paragraphs: Some deployments can be staged to reduce disruption, while others require an approved cutover window.
The actual interruption depends on the network architecture, redundancy, configuration and migration approach. Uninterrupted service should not be guaranteed without a verified design.

items.title: What are firewall rules or security policies?
paragraphs: Firewall rules define how particular traffic is handled based on criteria supported by the platform.
These may include source and destination networks, services, applications, users or security zones.
Policies should permit necessary business communications while restricting unnecessary access.

items.title: Can a firewall help separate guest Wi-Fi from the office network?
paragraphs: Yes. A properly designed network can use firewall policies and suitable network segmentation to restrict communications between guest, employee and other designated networks.
The complete arrangement may also depend on compatible switches, wireless equipment and routing configurations.

items.title: Can a firewall support secure connections between company branches?
paragraphs: Many enterprise firewalls support compatible site-to-site VPN arrangements.
Implementation depends on network connectivity, platform support, security requirements, addressing and the agreed configuration.

items.title: Can employees connect securely to office systems while working remotely?
paragraphs: Supported firewalls may provide remote-access VPN capabilities or integrate with other appropriate access solutions.
The specific features, authentication requirements, endpoint controls and licensing must be assessed for the selected platform.

items.title: What is included in a firewall licence?
paragraphs: There is no universal firewall licence package.
Depending on the vendor, subscriptions or entitlements may cover security updates, threat-prevention capabilities, filtering services, cloud-based features, technical support or management functions.
The exact product codes and services should be confirmed before purchase.

items.title: Is a firewall licence the same as a manufacturer support contract?
paragraphs: Not always.
Some manufacturers distinguish support contracts from security-service subscriptions, while others sell bundled packages.
The quotation should identify the actual entitlements and their terms.

items.title: What happens when a firewall security subscription expires?
paragraphs: The consequences depend on the manufacturer and subscription.
Some firewall functions may continue while specific security updates or cloud services become unavailable. Other features may stop operating or become restricted.
The effect should be checked against the exact device, firmware version and licence terms.

items.title: Can I renew the licence on an existing firewall?
paragraphs: Renewal may be possible for supported products where the relevant manufacturer entitlements remain available.
The device model, serial number, registered account, existing subscriptions and renewal eligibility should be reviewed before quotation.

items.title: What information is needed for a firewall licence renewal quote?
paragraphs: Useful information includes the manufacturer, exact model, serial number, current licence or service details and preferred subscription term.
The customer's registered support account may also be relevant.
Sensitive account credentials should not be shared through an ordinary quotation form.

items.title: Can you supply firewall licences without supplying new hardware?
paragraphs: Licence-only or subscription renewal requests may be considered for compatible, eligible devices.
Availability depends on the manufacturer, product lifecycle, account ownership and applicable commercial arrangements.

items.title: Can you help activate a firewall subscription?
paragraphs: Activation assistance may be included in the agreed scope.
The process depends on the manufacturer's registration procedures, device status, support account and entitlement requirements.

items.title: Can you transfer an existing firewall licence to a replacement device?
paragraphs: Licence transfer is not universally permitted.
Eligibility depends on the manufacturer's policy, product type, registration status and contractual terms. Transfer options must be confirmed before assuming that existing entitlements can be reused.

items.title: Can you upgrade an existing firewall instead of replacing it?
paragraphs: Some existing firewalls can benefit from supported software updates, configuration changes or additional licensed capabilities.
Replacement may be more appropriate when performance is inadequate, required features are unavailable or manufacturer support is ending.

items.title: Can you migrate configuration from one firewall to another?
paragraphs: Configuration migration may be included as a separately defined technical activity.
Compatibility, policy behaviour, network interfaces, VPN arrangements, software versions and rollback requirements must be reviewed before implementation.

items.title: Can a firewall prevent every cyberattack?
paragraphs: No. A firewall is one part of a broader cybersecurity programme.
It cannot eliminate every risk involving compromised credentials, malicious software, misconfiguration, unprotected endpoints or other attack methods.

items.title: Does firewall installation include penetration testing?
paragraphs: Not automatically.

Firewall deployment verification and formal penetration testing are different activities. Independent security assessment, vulnerability scanning or penetration testing must be explicitly defined and authorised if required.

items.title: Do you configure firewall logging and alerts?
paragraphs: Suitable logging or alert configuration may be included where supported by the selected platform.
Log retention, storage location, monitoring arrangements, privacy obligations and alert response should be agreed separately.

items.title: Does firewall installation include ongoing security monitoring?
paragraphs: Not automatically.

Installing a firewall does not create a managed security operations service. Continuous threat monitoring, incident response and managed firewall administration require defined capabilities, processes and contractual arrangements.

items.title: Can you provide firewall maintenance and updates?
paragraphs: Appropriate maintenance or update assistance can be discussed for supported equipment.
The scope should define firmware management, policy review, configuration backup, licence administration, change approvals and relevant support arrangements.

items.title: How long does firewall installation take?
paragraphs: The timeframe depends on the existing network, device type, configuration complexity, required VPNs, security policies, migration needs and testing.
A deployment plan should follow assessment of the environment and approved technical scope.

items.title: What do you need to prepare a firewall quotation?
paragraphs: Useful details include the organisation's location, existing network, approximate number of users, internet bandwidth, required ports, connected branches, preferred manufacturer and intended security features.
Existing firewall details, network diagrams and licence information may also help.

paragraphs: Contact Integrated Solutions Technology with your network environment, firewall requirements and whether you need new equipment, installation or licence renewal.
We can review the technical and procurement requirements and discuss the appropriate solution and quotation.
